Door Code: The access card is inside the box in front of the door.

To open the box, simply pull the cover as our team has already left it open. If a code is requested, please use 8080, as shown in the picture.

WiFi Name: X28P-2.4G-8759BC

WiFi Password: 4462B425

Upon arrival, kindly proceed to the reception for a smooth check-in. After collecting the access card from the box, please visit the reception again to activate it for the duration of your stay.
